intro: Tyrion is a covert gnome operative stationed inside Stormwind Keep. Operating in the shadows alongside close associates like Elling Trias, he aids adventurers in unearthing sensitive intelligence and combating treacherous plots against the kingdom.

sections.t: A Quiet Presence in the Keep
p: Amid the grandeur of Stormwind Keep, Tyrion keeps a low profile. While noble courtiers and royal guards bustle through the halls, this clever gnome operates under the radar, watching palace movements and liaising with outside contacts who operate far from official oversight.

Tyrion is a trusted confidant of Elling Trias, the renowned cheese merchant of the Trade District who operates a discreet information network. When sensitive matters arise that require bypassing the official bureaucracy of the House of Nobles, Trias directs reliable operatives straight to Tyrion inside the castle walls.
